name: Gedaliah
role: Governor of Judah after the fall of Jerusalem
whenBasis: The siege and fall of Jerusalem, dated by the Babylonian Chronicle and the regnal years Kings gives: 588–586 BC, and the few years after.
summary: Son of Ahikam and grandson of Shaphan, appointed by Nebuchadnezzar to govern those left in Judah after Jerusalem fell. He set up at Mizpah, took in Jeremiah, and told the scattered commanders to serve Babylon and gather wine, summer fruit and oil. Warned by Johanan son of Kareah that Ishmael son of Nethaniah meant to kill him, he refused to believe it; Ishmael, of the royal family, murdered him at a meal.
body: His father Ahikam had protected Jeremiah from being put to death under Jehoiakim. Gedaliah will not let Johanan kill Ishmael first: “What you are saying about Ishmael is a lie.” After his murder, the survivors, fearing Babylon, flee to Egypt, taking Jeremiah with them. The Talmud identifies the fast of the seventh month in Zechariah with mourning for him.

later.text: The Fast of Gedaliah, on the third of Tishri, is kept in Jewish tradition for his murder, identified with the fast of the seventh month in Zechariah.
